item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A warm maritime airstream will affect the coastal areas of Guangdong gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be humid and foggy over the region. Under the influence of the upper-air disturbance, there will be showers over southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 13/03 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny periods. Misty at night.
Temp range: 20 - 26 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
